theorem contDiffAt_fixedPoint_of_invertible
    {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P] [CompleteSpace P]
    {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] [CompleteSpace X]
    {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {T : P × X → X} {u : P → X} {p : P}
    (hT : ContDiffAt ℝ n T (p, u p)) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hInv : (fderiv ℝ (fun z : P × X => z.2 - T z) (p, u p) ∘L
      ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ P X).IsInvertible)
    (hu : ContinuousAt u p)
    (hfix : ∀ᶠ q in nhds p, T (q, u q) = u q) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ n u p := by
  let R : P × X → X := fun z => z.2 - T z
  have hR : ContDiffAt ℝ n R (p, u p) := contDiffAt_snd.sub hT
  let v : P → X := hR.implicitFunction hn hInv
  have hv : ContDiffAt ℝ n v p := hR.contDiffAt_implicitFunction hn hInv
  have hzero : R (p, u p) = 0 := by simp [R, hfix.self_of_nhds]
  have hpair : Filter.Tendsto (fun q => (q, u q)) (nhds p) (nhds (p, u p)) :=
    continuousAt_id.prodMk hu
  have heq : ∀ᶠ q in nhds p, u q = v q := by
    filter_upwards [hpair.eventually (hR.eventually_apply_eq_iff_implicitFunction hn hInv),
      hfix] with q hq hqfix
    exact (hq.mp (by simp [R, hqfix, hzero])).symm
  exact hv.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq

  let R : P × X → X := fun z => z.2 - T z
  have hRW : ContDiffOn ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) R U := contDiffOn_snd.sub hT

# Endpoint continuation checkpoint

Researcher-1, task `help_0c851f27764e41568882661e4f1f9e37`.

## Saved, checked additions

Seven complete Mathlib-only helpers were added before the pre-existing
Levi-Civita helpers in `generated/hopf_rinow/Submission/Helpers.lean`:

- `coordinate_spray_energy_hasDerivAt_zero`: the coordinate Koszul identity,
  symmetry of the metric, and `x′ = v`, `v′ = -Γ(x)(v,v)` imply that
  `g(x)(v,v)` has derivative zero.
- `coordinate_spray_energy_eq`: energy is constant on any connected open
  parameter set.
- `positive_bilinear_uniform_lower_bound`: compactness of the unit sphere gives
  `k > 0` with `k * ‖v‖² ≤ g(v,v)` in finite dimension.
- `positive_metric_eventually_uniform_lower_bound`: continuity of `g` propagates
  that lower bound to a neighborhood of the limiting position.
- `endpoint_limit_of_eventually_bounded_deriv`: a curve on a finite open interval
  with eventually bounded derivative has an endpoint limit in a complete normed
  space. The proof uses the convex-set mean value theorem and Cauchy completeness.
- `coordinate_spray_velocity_endpoint_limit`: a coordinate spray solution with
  constant energy and a position limit has a velocity limit. The local metric
  lower bound bounds velocity; bounded `Γ` then bounds acceleration.
- `coordinate_spray_phase_endpoint_limit`: combines energy conservation and the
  preceding estimate to produce a phase limit `(x,v) → (p,w)` from the actual
  Koszul identity and coordinate ODE, without a separate energy hypothesis.

No imports, existing declarations, original proof, or protected files changed.
Helper-specific normed operator-space instances remain inside their proofs.
`Submission.lean` is unchanged; its checked forward completeness implication
and the abstract metric extension core are preserved.

The phase-limit construction removes smooth dependence of solutions from the
*ODE endpoint estimate*. It does not prove `HasMetricEndpointGerms M`: the input
curve there is only locally distance-linear, whereas the new lemmas require the
coordinate ODE. In addition, the outgoing ODE solution must be locally minimizing
to recover the exact distance identity. Neither statement follows from energy
conservation or endpoint convergence alone.

chart expression of a `MetricLocallyLinear` curve, prove…

theorem rescaled_picard_unique
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {S : Set E} {f : E → E} {K : NNReal} (hf : LipschitzOnWith K f S)
    {h : ℝ} (hh : ‖h‖ * K < 1) {y : E}
    {A B : ContinuousMap (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) E}
    (hAS : ∀ s, A s ∈ S) (hBS : ∀ s, B s ∈ S)
    (hA : ∀ s : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      A s = y + h • ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..(s : ℝ),
        f (A (Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one τ)))
    (hB : ∀ s : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      B s = y + h • ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..(s : ℝ),
        f (B (Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one τ))) : A = B := by
  have hAc : Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => f (A (Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one τ))) :=
    hf.continuousOn.comp_continuous (A.continuous.comp continuous_projIcc)
      (fun τ => hAS _)
  have hBc : Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => f (B (Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one τ))) :=
    hf.continuousOn.comp_continuous (B.continuous.comp continuous_projIcc)
      (fun τ => hBS _)
  have hn : ‖A - B‖ ≤ (‖h‖ * K) * ‖A - B‖ := by
    apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (by positivity)).mpr
    intro s
    change ‖A s - B s‖ ≤ _
    rw [hA s, hB s, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← smul_sub,
      ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hAc.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        (hBc.intervalIntegrable _ _), norm_smul]
    have hi : ‖∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..(s : ℝ),
        (f (A (Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one τ)) -
          f (B (Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one τ)))‖ ≤ K * ‖A - B‖ := by
      calc
        _ ≤ (K * ‖A - B‖) * |(s : ℝ) - 0| :=
          intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (fun τ _ =>
            (hf.norm_sub_le (hAS _) (hBS _)).trans
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((A - B).norm_coe_le_norm _) K.2))
        _ ≤ K * ‖A - B‖ := by
          rw [sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg s.2.1]
          exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) s.2.2
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖h‖ * (K * ‖A - B‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi (norm_nonneg h)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hz : ‖A - B‖ = 0 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (A - B)]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp hz)

theorem mul_mem_time_interval {h δ s : ℝ} (hh : |h| < δ)
    (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : h * s ∈ Set.Ioo (-δ) δ := by
  apply abs_lt.mp
  calc
    |h * s| = |h| * s := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hs.1]
    _ ≤ |h| := mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg h) hs.2
    _ < δ := hh

# Current checkpoint: automatic Gauss identity for a smooth coordinate family

Task `help_d0cadf5068b44fdcbc1203a6221b85ae`, researcher-2.

## Checked result

New `Submission.Helpers.coordinate_gauss_radial_pairing_of_contDiffOn` is saved at `generated/hopf_rinow/Submission/Helpers.lean:304`.

Let `X V : ℝ × ℝ → E`, `R S : Set ℝ`, and `p v w : E`. Assume:

- `R` and `S` are open; `S` is preconnected and contains zero;
- `X` is C² and `V` is C¹ on `R ×ˢ S`;
- `g` is differentiable along `X`, globally symmetric, and `Γ` satisfies the explicit coordinate Koszul identity along the family;
- `∂t X = V` and `∂t V = -Γ(X)VV` on the product domain;
- `X(r,0)=p` and `V(r,0)=v+r•w` for `r ∈ R`.

Then, for every `s ∈ R` and `t ∈ S`,

`g (X (s,t)) (V (s,t)) (fderiv ℝ X (s,t) (1,0)) = t * g p (v+s•w) w`.

No extra variation identities, initial variation derivative assumptions, finite-dimensionality, completeness, or positivity are required.

The proof defines `J=∂sX`, `W=∂sV`. Slice derivative helpers identify these derivatives. The explicit time identity implies `∂tX=V` as a local equality of functions on an open product; `Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq` differentiates it in the first direction. The checked symmetric-second-derivative lemma then gives `∂tJ=W`. Differentiating the local initial equalities gives `J(s,0)=0` and `W(s,0)=w`. The result follows from `coordinate_gauss_radial_pairing`.

Two small supporting declarations were added:

- `hasDerivAt_coordinate_first_slice` (line 288);
- `hasDerivAt_coordinate_second_slice` (line 296).

Exact hypotheses: a real normed space `E`, a function
`Φ : ℝ × (E × E) → E × E`, a real `t`, vectors `p v V : E`,
`DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (t,(p,v))`, the time-slice derivative
`HasDerivAt (fun s => (Φ (s,(p,v))).1) V t`, and

`∀ κ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, (Φ (t,(p,κ • v))).1 = (Φ (κ*t,(p,v))).1`.

`(fderiv ℝ Φ (t,(p,v)) (0,(0,v))).1 = t • V`.

The proof differentiates the velocity-scaling path at `κ=1` by the Frechet
chain rule and differentiates the time-scaling path by the scalar chain
rule. The two paths agree on `[0,1]`, so the right path's derivative can be
transferred to the left path within that interval.

two derivatives at the endpoint. No full neighborhood scaling equality is
needed. Neither `t ≠ 0`, a spray, finite dimensionality, completeness, nor

# Current checkpoint: constant coordinate energy and path length

Research task `help_09bd1055fe214657989e4c337c3b026e`, engineer.
The assigned independent path-length bridge is complete. Added three checked
helpers at the start of `generated/hopf_rinow/Submission/Helpers.lean`.
Existing imports, declarations, options, and namespace context are unchanged;
all new scopes/instances are local to their statements/proofs. Submission is
unchanged. The current seed does not contain the earlier coordinate metric
construction; these helpers take its exact quadratic identity as a premise.

## Checked declarations and exact premises

All helpers assume only a real normed model E, a C1 manifold M modeled by I,
and `Bundle.RiemannianBundle (fun z : M => TangentSpace I z)`. Let
`c = extChartAt I p` and `g : E → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ`. Their common metric
premise is exactly:

```lean
∀ z ∈ (extChartAt I p).target, ∀ w : E,
  g z w w = ‖mfderivWithin (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) I
    (extChartAt I p).symm (Set.range I) z w‖ ^ 2
```

The norms use the scoped Bundle Riemannian instance.

- `norm_mfderivWithin_inverse_chart_curve` (:29): for x:ℝ→E mapping S into
  c.target, t∈S, `UniqueDiffWithinAt ℝ S t`, and `HasDerivWithinAt x v S t`,
  concludes
  `‖mfderivWithin self I (c.symm ∘ x) S t 1‖ = sqrt(g(x t) v v)`.
  Uses `mfderivWithin_comp` with the exact inverse-chart derivative within
  range I, and identifies the coordinate derivative evaluated at 1 with v.
- `pathELength_inverse_chart_eq_of_constant_energy` (:65): for x,v:ℝ→E,
  a≤b, k≥0, x maps Icc a b into c.target, x'=v within Icc a b at every point,
  and `g(x t)(v t)(v t)=k^2` there, concludes
  `Manifold.pathELength I (c.symm ∘ x) a b = ENNReal.ofReal ((b-a)*k)`.
  Handles a=b separately. For a<b it applies the pointwise helper and
  integrates the constant speed using the within-Icc length formula.
  It needs no C1 curve premise. HasDerivAt implies the within derivative
  premise directly via `.hasDerivWithinAt`.
- `riemannianEDist_inverse_chart_le_of_constant_energy` (:106): under the same
  premises and `ContDiffOn ℝ 1 x (Icc a b)`, concludes
  `riemannianEDist I (c.symm(x a)) (c.symm(x b)) ≤ ofReal((b-a)*k)`.
  Constructs the C1 manifold path by composing x with c.symm, then applies
  `riemannianEDist_le_pathELength` and the checked length formula.

No finite dimension, boundarylessness, metric continuity/smoothness,
completeness, or symmetry/positivity of g is needed beyond the displayed
identity and energy equation. This applies directly to a smooth coordinate
spray curve once its constant energy is supplied. For actual `edist`, the
lead can rewrite with `IsRiemannianManifold.out`.

theorem exists_smooth_compact_primitive_of_integral_zero : open MeasureTheory in
    ∀ (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (φ : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hφ : ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport φ) (hsub : tsupport φ ⊆ Set.Ioo a b)
    (hint : (∫ t : ℝ, φ t) = 0),
    ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ψ ∧
      HasCompactSupport ψ ∧ tsupport ψ ⊆ Set.Ioo a b ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, deriv ψ t = φ t := by
  intro a b hab φ hφ hcompact hsub hint
  classical
  let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => ∫ s in a..t, φ s
  have hderiv (t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt ψ (φ t) t :=
    (hφ.continuous.integral_hasStrictDerivAt a t).hasDerivAt
  have hderiv_eq : deriv ψ = φ := funext fun t => (hderiv t).deriv
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ψ :=
    contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.mpr
      ⟨fun t => (hderiv t).differentiableAt, hderiv_eq.symm ▸ hφ⟩
  by_cases hne : (tsupport φ).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hcompact.isCompact.exists_isLeast hne
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hcompact.isCompact.exists_isGreatest hne
    have hac : a < c := (hsub hc.1).1
    have hdb : d < b := (hsub hd.1).2
    have hleft (t : ℝ) (ht : t < c) : ψ t = 0 := by
      change (∫ s in a..t, φ s) = 0
      calc
        (∫ s in a..t, φ s) = ∫ s in a..t, (0 : ℝ) := by
          apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_uIoo
          intro s hs
          have hsc : s < c := lt_trans hs.2 (max_lt hac ht)
          by_contra hφs
          exact (not_le_of_gt hsc) (hc.2 (subset_tsupport φ hφs))
        _ = 0 := by simp
    have hright (t : ℝ) (ht : d < t) : ψ t = 0 := by
      change (∫ s in a..t, φ s) = 0
      refine (intervalIntegral.integral_eq_integral_of_support_subset ?_).trans hint
      intro s hs
      have hs' : s ∈ tsupport φ := subset_tsupport φ hs
      exact ⟨(hsub hs').1, (hd.2 hs').trans ht.le⟩
    have hsupport : Function.support ψ ⊆ Set.Icc c d := by
      intro t ht
      change ψ t ≠ 0 at ht
      constructor
      · by_contra hct
        exact ht (hleft t (lt_of_not_ge hct))
      · by_contra htd
        exact ht (hright t (lt_of_not_ge htd))
    have htsupport : tsupport ψ ⊆ Set.Icc c d :=
      closure_minimal hsupport isClosed_Icc
    refine ⟨ψ, hsmooth,
      HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact isCompact_Icc hsupport, ?_,
      fun t => (hderiv t).deriv⟩
    intro t ht
    exact ⟨hac.trans_le (htsupport ht).1, lt_of_le_of_lt (htsupport ht).2 hdb⟩
  · have hφzero : φ = 0 := tsupport_eq_empty_iff.mp
      (Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne)
    refine ⟨0, contDiff_const, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact (K := (∅ : Set ℝ))
        isCompact_empty (by simp)
    · simp
    · intro t
      simp [hφzero]

import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.Bounded.ArzelaAscoli

theorem approximate_radial_split_probe
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {H : Type*} [TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H)
    {M : Type*} [MetricSpace M] [ChartedSpace H M]
    [(x : M) → ENorm (TangentSpace I x)]
    [∀ x : M, ENormSMulClass ℝ (TangentSpace I x)]
    (hmetric : ∀ x y : M, edist x y = Manifold.riemannianEDist I x y)
    (x y : M) (r ε : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrd : r ≤ dist x y) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ z : M, dist x z = r ∧ dist z y < dist x y - r + ε := open Bundle in by
  have htotalpos : 0 < dist x y + ε := by positivity
  have hd : Manifold.riemannianEDist I x y < ENNReal.ofReal (dist x y + ε) := by
    rw [← hmetric, edist_dist]
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff htotalpos).2 (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ0, hγ1, hγ, hlen⟩ := Manifold.exists_lt_of_riemannianEDist_lt hd
  have hf : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => dist x (γ t)) (Set.Icc 0 1) :=
    continuous_dist.continuousOn.comp
      (continuousOn_const.prodMk hγ.continuousOn) (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
  have hrim : r ∈ Set.Icc (dist x (γ 0)) (dist x (γ 1)) := by
    simpa [hγ0, hγ1] using (show r ∈ Set.Icc 0 (dist x y) from ⟨hr, hrd⟩)
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htr⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) hf hrim
  refine ⟨γ t, htr, ?_⟩
  have hpre : ENNReal.ofReal r ≤ Manifold.pathELength I γ 0 t := by
    rw [← htr, ← edist_dist, hmetric]
    exact Manifold.riemannianEDist_le_pathELength
      (hγ.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl ht.2)) hγ0 rfl ht.1
  have hsuf : ENNReal.ofReal (dist (γ t) y) ≤ Manifold.pathELength I γ t 1 := by
    rw [← edist_dist, hmetric]
    exact Manifold.riemannianEDist_le_pathELength
      (hγ.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc ht.1 le_rfl)) rfl hγ1 ht.2
  have hsum : ENNReal.ofReal r + ENNReal.ofReal (dist (γ t) y) <

    calc
      _ ≤ Manifold.pathELength I γ 0 t + Manifold.pathELength I γ t 1 := add_le_add hpre hsuf
      _ = Manifold.pathELength I γ 0 1 := Manifold.pathELength_add ht.1 ht.2

Submission.Helpers.isGeodesicallyComplete_of_endpointGerm.{u_1} (M : Type u_1) [EMetricSpace M] [CompleteSpace M] :
  have L := fun γ c S =>
    ∀ t₀ ∈ S,
      ∃ δ > 0,
        ∀ (s t : ℝ),
          s ∈ S ∩ Set.Ioo (t₀ - δ) (t₀ + δ) →
            t ∈ S ∩ Set.Ioo (t₀ - δ) (t₀ + δ) → edist (γ s) (γ t) = ↑c * ENNReal.ofReal |t - s|;
  (∀ (a b : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → M) (c : NNReal) (p : M),
      a < b →
        L γ c (Set.Ioo a b) →
          Filter.Tendsto γ (nhdsWithin b (Set.Ioo a b)) (nhds p) →
            ∃ ε > 0, ∃ η, L η c (Set.Ioo (b - ε) (b + ε)) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (max a (b - ε)) b, η t = γ t) →
    IsGeodesicallyComplete M

Task `normal_neighborhood_plan`, researcher-1. Advisory research only. Neither
original implication nor `Submission.hopf_rinow` is proved. The original theorem
still has its original `sorry`. All temporary Lean imports, probes, helpers,
and proposition definitions are removed before delivery; both owned Lean files
are restored byte-for-byte. Checked code below is available for review, not an
integrated declaration in the final helper module.

## Main finding and next assignment

The next independent analytic obligation should be **smooth dependence of the
coordinate spray flow on its initial data**. The inspected installed ODE API
provides local solutions, uniqueness, and continuous/Lipschitz dependence, but
not the differentiable dependence needed by the exponential-map argument.
The existence of each separate integral curve is insufficient for an inverse
function theorem or the two-parameter differentiation in Gauss' lemma.

The smallest useful closed assignment for that step is the following `Prop`.
Its definition elaborated successfully, but no proof of its value is supplied.
`(↑(⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞)` is the fully explicit spelling of smoothness `∞`;
this avoids adding a file-level scope to the frozen helper context.

```lean
def smooth_spray_flow_statement_probe : Prop :=
  ∀ {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
    (U : Set E), IsOpen U →
    ∀ (Γ : E → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] E),
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) Γ U →
    ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ W : Set (E × E), IsOpen W ∧ (x, 0) ∈ W ∧
      ∃ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∃ Φ : (E × E) × ℝ → E × E,
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) Φ (W ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ W, Φ (z, 0) = z) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ W, ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, (Φ (z, t)).1 ∈ U) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ W, ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε,
          HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (z, s))
            ((Φ (z, t)).2, -(Γ (Φ (z, t)).1 (Φ (z, t)).2 (Φ (z, t)).2)) t)
```

The flow must include varying base points, not just varying velocities at one
fixed point. This permits a uniform normal neighborhood for nearby centers.
No finite-dimensionality, metric, completeness of the eventual manifold, or
Levi-Civita class is hidden in this proposition. Completeness here belongs only
to the coordinate Banach space `E`, as required by Picard-Lindelof; the original
finite-dimensional real `E` supplies it. A finite-regularity version with C2
coefficients and C2 flow would suffice for the initial Gauss-lemma development.
The smooth version avoids repeated regularity bookkeeping under the frozen
smooth hypotheses.

continuation of a frozen metric geodesic. They use only the coefficient field

theorem exists_global_locallyLinear_extension_of_endpointGerm
    (M : Type*) [EMetricSpace M] [CompleteSpace M] :
    let L : (ℝ → M) → NNReal → Set ℝ → Prop := fun γ c S =>
      ∀ t₀ ∈ S, ∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∀ s t : ℝ,
        s ∈ S ∩ Set.Ioo (t₀ - δ) (t₀ + δ) →
        t ∈ S ∩ Set.Ioo (t₀ - δ) (t₀ + δ) →
        edist (γ s) (γ t) = (c : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal |t - s|
    (∀ (a b : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → M) (c : NNReal) (p : M),
      a < b → L γ c (Set.Ioo a b) →
      Filter.Tendsto γ (nhdsWithin b (Set.Ioo a b)) (nhds p) →
      ∃ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∃ η : ℝ → M,
        L η c (Set.Ioo (b - ε) (b + ε)) ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (max a (b - ε)) b, η t = γ t) →
    ∀ (a b : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → M) (c : NNReal), a < b → L γ c (Set.Ioo a b) →
      ∃ η : ℝ → M, L η c Set.univ ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, η t = γ t := by
  change HasMetricEndpointGerms M →
    ∀ (a b : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → M) (c : NNReal), a < b →
      MetricLocallyLinear γ c (Set.Ioo a b) →
      ∃ η : ℝ → M, MetricLocallyLinear η c Set.univ ∧ Set.EqOn η γ (Set.Ioo a b)
  intro hG a b γ c hab hγ
  let u₀ : MetricLinearExtension γ c (Set.Ioo a b) :=
    ⟨⟨Set.Ioo a b, γ⟩, isOpen_Ioo, Set.ordConnected_Ioo, Set.Subset.rfl,
      hγ, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  letI : Nonempty (MetricLinearExtension γ c (Set.Ioo a b)) := ⟨u₀⟩
  have hex : ∃ u : MetricLinearExtension γ c (Set.Ioo a b),
      ∀ v, u.Extends v → v.Extends u := by
    apply exists_maximal_of_nonempty_chains_bounded
    · intro C hC hne
      exact MetricLinearExtension.chain_bound C hC hne
    · intro u v w huv hvw
      exact MetricLinearExtension.extends_trans huv hvw
  obtain ⟨u, hmax⟩ := hex
  have hne : u.domain.Nonempty :=
    ⟨(a + b) / 2, u.contains ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
  have habove : ¬ BddAbove u.domain := by
    intro hbdd
    obtain ⟨T, η, hT, hTc, hST, hη, heq, t, htT, htS⟩ :=
      metricLocallyLinear_extend_bddAbove hG u.isOpen u.ordConnected hne hbdd u.linear
    let v : MetricLinearExtension γ c (Set.Ioo a b) :=
      ⟨⟨T, η⟩, hT, hTc, u.contains.trans hST, hη,
        fun s hs => (heq (u.contains hs)).trans (u.agrees hs)⟩
    have huv : u.Extends v := ⟨hST, heq⟩
    exact htS ((hmax v huv).1 htT)
  have hbelow : ¬ BddBelow u.domain := by
    intro hbdd
    obtain ⟨T, η, hT, hTc, hST, hη, heq, t, htT, htS⟩ :=
      metricLocallyLinear_extend_bddBelow hG u.isOpen u.ordConnected hne hbdd u.linear
    let v : MetricLinearExtension γ c (Set.Ioo a b) :=
      ⟨⟨T, η⟩, hT, hTc, u.contains.trans hST, hη,
        fun s hs => (heq (u.contains hs)).trans (u.agrees hs)⟩
    have huv : u.Extends v := ⟨hST, heq⟩
    exact htS ((hmax v huv).1 htT)
  have hfull : u.domain = Set.univ :=
    u.ordConnected.isPreconnected.eq_univ_of_unbounded hbelow habove
  refine ⟨u.curve, ?_, u.agrees⟩
  simpa only [← hfull] using u.linear

Submission.Helpers.exists_global_locallyLinear_extension_of_endpointGerm.{u_1} (M : Type u_1) [EMetricSpace M]
  [CompleteSpace M] :
  have L := fun γ c S =>
    ∀ t₀ ∈ S,
      ∃ δ > 0,
        ∀ (s t : ℝ),
          s ∈ S ∩ Set.Ioo (t₀ - δ) (t₀ + δ) →
            t ∈ S ∩ Set.Ioo (t₀ - δ) (t₀ + δ) → edist (γ s) (γ t) = ↑c * ENNReal.ofReal |t - s|;
  (∀ (a b : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → M) (c : NNReal) (p : M),
      a < b →
        L γ c (Set.Ioo a b) →
          Filter.Tendsto γ (nhdsWithin b (Set.Ioo a b)) (nhds p) →
            ∃ ε > 0, ∃ η, L η c (Set.Ioo (b - ε) (b + ε)) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (max a (b - ε)) b, η t = γ t) →
    ∀ (a b : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → M) (c : NNReal),
      a < b → L γ c (Set.Ioo a b) → ∃ η, L η c Set.univ ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, η t = γ t
DEEPSCIENTIST_DECL_END_e6232756f6ae6309

Submission.Helpers.exists_smooth_coordinate_koszul.{u_1} {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (U : Set E) (hU : IsOpen U) (g : E → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) g U)
  (_hsym : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ (v w : E), ((g x) v) w = ((g x) w) v) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ (v : E), v ≠ 0 → 0 < ((g x) v) v) :
  ∃ Γ,
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) Γ U ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U,
        ∀ (v w z : E),
          2 * ((g x) (((Γ x) v) w)) z = (((fderiv ℝ g x) v) w) z + (((fderiv ℝ g x) w) v) z - (((fderiv ℝ g x) z) v) w

theorem Helpers.isGeodesicallyComplete_of_endpointGerm : open Bundle in
    ∀ (M : Type*) [EMetricSpace M] [CompleteSpace M],
    let L : (ℝ → M) → NNReal → Set ℝ → Prop := fun γ c S =>
      ∀ t₀ ∈ S, ∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∀ s t : ℝ,
        s ∈ S ∩ Set.Ioo (t₀ - δ) (t₀ + δ) →
        t ∈ S ∩ Set.Ioo (t₀ - δ) (t₀ + δ) →
        edist (γ s) (γ t) = (c : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal |t - s|
    (∀ (a b : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → M) (c : NNReal) (p : M),
      a < b → L γ c (Set.Ioo a b) →
      Filter.Tendsto γ (nhdsWithin b (Set.Ioo a b)) (nhds p) →
      ∃ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∃ η : ℝ → M,
        L η c (Set.Ioo (b - ε) (b + ε)) ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (max a (b - ε)) b, η t = γ t) →
    LeanEval.Geometry.IsGeodesicallyComplete M := by
  intro M _ _
  dsimp only
  intro hG a b γ hab hγ
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hγ
  have hlin : Helpers.MetricLocallyLinear γ c (Set.Ioo a b) := by
    intro t₀ ht₀
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, H⟩ := hc t₀ ht₀
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun s t hs ht => H s t ?_ ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨max_lt hs.1.1 hs.2.1, lt_min hs.1.2 hs.2.2⟩
    · exact ⟨max_lt ht.1.1 ht.2.1, lt_min ht.1.2 ht.2.2⟩
  obtain ⟨η, hη, heq⟩ :=
    Helpers.exists_global_locallyLinear_extension_of_endpointGerm M hG a b γ c hab hlin
  refine ⟨η, ⟨c, ?_⟩, heq⟩
  intro t₀
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, H⟩ := hη t₀ (Set.mem_univ _)
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun s t hs ht => H s t ⟨Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    ⟨Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨hs₁, hs₂⟩ := abs_lt.mp hs
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · obtain ⟨ht₁, ht₂⟩ := abs_lt.mp ht
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

Submission.Helpers.isGeodesicallyComplete_of_endpointGerm.{u_1} (M : Type u_1) [EMetricSpace M] [CompleteSpace M] :
  have L := fun γ c S =>
    ∀ t₀ ∈ S,
      ∃ δ > 0,
        ∀ (s t : ℝ),
          s ∈ S ∩ Set.Ioo (t₀ - δ) (t₀ + δ) →
            t ∈ S ∩ Set.Ioo (t₀ - δ) (t₀ + δ) → edist (γ s) (γ t) = ↑c * ENNReal.ofReal |t - s|;
  (∀ (a b : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → M) (c : NNReal) (p : M),
      a < b →
        L γ c (Set.Ioo a b) →
          Filter.Tendsto γ (nhdsWithin b (Set.Ioo a b)) (nhds p) →
            ∃ ε > 0, ∃ η, L η c (Set.Ioo (b - ε) (b + ε)) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (max a (b - ε)) b, η t = γ t) →
    IsGeodesicallyComplete M

theorem positive_metric_duality_isInvertible
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (g : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ v : E, v ≠ 0 → 0 < g v v) : g.IsInvertible := by
  classical
  have hinj : Function.Injective g := by
    intro v w hvw
    by_contra hne
    have hz : g (v - w) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, hvw, sub_self]
    have hp := hpos (v - w) (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
    simp [hz] at hp
  have hdim : Module.finrank ℝ E = Module.finrank ℝ (E →L[ℝ] ℝ) := by
    rw [← (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap :
      Module.Dual ℝ E ≃ₗ[ℝ] (E →L[ℝ] ℝ)).finrank_eq, Subspace.dual_finrank_eq]
  let e := (LinearEquiv.ofBijective g.toLinearMap
    ⟨hinj, (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank hdim).mp hinj⟩
      ).toContinuousLinearEquiv
  exact ⟨e, rfl⟩

Submission.Helpers.isGeodesicallyComplete_of_endpointGerm.{u_1} (M : Type u_1) [EMetricSpace M] [CompleteSpace M] :
  have L := fun γ c S =>
    ∀ t₀ ∈ S,
      ∃ δ > 0,
        ∀ (s t : ℝ),
          s ∈ S ∩ Set.Ioo (t₀ - δ) (t₀ + δ) →
            t ∈ S ∩ Set.Ioo (t₀ - δ) (t₀ + δ) → edist (γ s) (γ t) = ↑c * ENNReal.ofReal |t - s|;
  (∀ (a b : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → M) (c : NNReal) (p : M),
      a < b →
        L γ c (Set.Ioo a b) →
          Filter.Tendsto γ (nhdsWithin b (Set.Ioo a b)) (nhds p) →
            ∃ ε > 0, ∃ η, L η c (Set.Ioo (b - ε) (b + ε)) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (max a (b - ε)) b, η t = γ t) →
    IsGeodesicallyComplete M

theorem radial_gauss_cauchy_schwarz
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B B₀ : E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hsymm : ∀ v w : E, B v w = B w v)
    (hnonneg : ∀ v : E, 0 ≤ B v v)
    (L : E →L[ℝ] E) (u : E)
    (hGauss : ∀ w : E, B (L u) (L w) = B₀ u w) (w : E) :
    |B₀ u w| ≤ Real.sqrt (B₀ u u) * Real.sqrt (B (L w) (L w)) := by
  have hdisc := discrim_le_zero
    (a := B (L u) (L u)) (b := 2 * B (L u) (L w))
    (c := B (L w) (L w)) (fun t : ℝ => by
      have h := hnonneg (t • L u + L w)
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, add_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h
      rw [hsymm (L w) (L u)] at h
      nlinarith)
  have hsq : B (L u) (L w) ^ 2 ≤ B (L u) (L u) * B (L w) (L w) := by
    dsimp [discrim] at hdisc
    nlinarith
  have h := Real.abs_le_sqrt hsq
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul (hnonneg (L u))] at h
  simpa only [hGauss] using h

task.objective: Inspected/independently rechecked compact primitive 03226cb. Next narrow analytic Dubois–Reymond supporting lemma: locally integrable Banach-valued P on interval whose integrals against all derivatives of smooth compactly supported scalar tests vanish equals a constant a.e. on interval. Your checked compact primitive makes every zero-integral test a derivative. Fix normalized bump θ inside interval (integral=1), set C=∫θ P; subtract (∫φ)θ from each test and use installed fundamental lemma. Verify exact locally integrable smul and bump API early. Keep full exact target below; no need weak Q primitive/integration by parts yet. Preserve current helpers.
task.type: open MeasureTheory in ∀ {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F] (a b : ℝ), a < b → ∀ P : ℝ → F, LocallyIntegrableOn P (Set.Ioo a b) → (∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ Set.Ioo a b → (∫ t : ℝ, deriv φ t • P t) = 0) → ∃ C : F, ∀ᵐ t : ℝ, t ∈ Set.Ioo a b → P t = C

theorem eq_affine_of_hasDerivAt_sq_zero
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (A : E →L[ℝ] E) (hA : A.comp A = 0) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hS : IsOpen S) (hconn : IsPreconnected S) (h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ S)
    (X : ℝ → E) (hX : ∀ t ∈ S, HasDerivAt X (A (X t)) t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ S) :
    X t = X 0 + t • A (X 0) := by
  have hAX : ∀ u ∈ S, HasDerivAt (fun s => A (X s)) 0 u := by
    intro u hu
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, ← ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hA,
      zero_apply] using
      (A.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt u (hX u hu))
  have hAX_const : ∀ u ∈ S, A (X u) = A (X 0) := by
    intro u hu
    exact hS.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hconn
      (fun s hs => (hAX s hs).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
      (fun s hs => (hAX s hs).deriv) hu h0
  have hline : ∀ u : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun s => X 0 + s • A (X 0)) (A (X 0)) u := by
    intro u
    simpa only [id_eq, one_smul] using
      ((hasDerivAt_id u).smul_const (A (X 0))).const_add (X 0)
  apply hS.eqOn_of_deriv_eq hconn
    (fun s hs => (hX s hs).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
    (fun s _ => (hline s).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt) ?_ h0
    (by simp) ht
  intro s hs
  rw [(hX s hs).deriv, (hline s).deriv]
  exact hAX_const s hs

# Current checkpoint: smooth coordinate metric

Task `help_7a3a71483855461a996b153d3aecf25f`, researcher-2.

## Checked addition

`Submission.Helpers.exists_smooth_coordinate_metric` is saved at `generated/hopf_rinow/Submission/Helpers.lean:41`, immediately after its existing supporting lemma `contMDiffAt_clm_of_apply`. It assumes the original smooth finite-dimensional boundaryless manifold and Riemannian bundle hypotheses (no distance, completeness, connectedness, or compactness assumptions are needed).

For each `p : M` it gives `g : E → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ` with:

- `ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g (extChartAt I p).target`;
- symmetry for every coordinate point;
- strict positivity on nonzero vectors in the chart target;

Let `X V : ℝ × ℝ → E`, `R S : Set ℝ`, and `p v w : E`. Assume:

- `R` and `S` are open; `S` is preconnected and contains zero;
- `X` is C² and `V` is C¹ on `R ×ˢ S`;

      |Real.sqrt (B₀ (γ b) (γ b)) - Real.sqrt (B₀ (γ a) (γ a))| ≤
